reference: Xie et al. (2016) + IDEC joint reconstruction (Guo et al., 2017)

selected_model.selection_rule: Composite multi-criteria score combining feature-space Silhouette (0.30), latent-space Silhouette (0.15), inverted DBI (0.20), multi-seed ARI (0.20), cluster balance min_share (0.10, hard floor >= 0.05), and spatial coherence lift (0.05).
